description: Two-face content toggle with accessible state management. The hidden face is made inert; with no [data-swap] triggers a real toggle button is generated (visually hidden until focused) and surface clicks swap for pointer users. Also available as the [data-swap] attribute form on any element with [data-face] children.

attributes.name: transition
attributes.description: Transition effect between faces. The attribute form uses data-transition.

attributes.name: swapped
attributes.description: Showing the back face. Reflected by the runtime; may be set or removed by authors at any time and inert follows it. The attribute form uses data-swapped.

attributes.name: card
attributes.description: Apply layout-card visual shell (pair with data-variant: elevated, outlined, ghost)

events.name: content-swap:swap
events.description: Fired after the faces swap; source is what caused it

properties.name: swapped
properties.description: Get or set whether the back face is showing

childAttributes.name: data-face
childAttributes.description: Marks the front and back faces

childAttributes.name: data-swap
childAttributes.description: Explicit swap trigger. When present, the surface is not clickable and no toggle is generated.

childAttributes.name: data-swap-toggle
childAttributes.description: Toggle used when there are no data-swap triggers; generated with the text "Show back" if absent. Author one to set the label. Receives aria-pressed.
